stories.title: Jamia B.Tech student gets Rs 35 lakh a year pre-placement offer from VISA
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia's press release of Wednesday 30 September says a B.Tech student of the university has secured a pre-placement offer from VISA with a package of Rs 35 lakh a year (LPA). The release is published in English, Hindi and Urdu versions on the university's press release page. The page itself carries only this headline-level announcement. It does not name the department or batch, and it does not describe the selection process or the role offered.
stories.check: Open the full release or ask Jamia's placement cell for the department, role and whether the figure is a total annual package.

stories.title: Jamia Electrical Engineering department holds Industry-Academia Connect-26
stories.body: Jamia's Department of Electrical Engineering organised 'Industry-Academia Connect-26', according to a university press release dated Wednesday 30 September. The release says the event brought together faculty, business leaders, human resources professionals and alumni, and drew more than 350 student participants. It describes the gathering as a platform for networking and career engagement between the university and the corporate sector. The release page does not give the venue, the date of the event or the names of the companies present; a detailed PDF version is attached to the release.
stories.check: The venue, event date and participating companies are not stated on the release page; check the attached PDF.

stories.title: Jamia teacher training centre concludes six-day programme on Indian Knowledge System
stories.body: Jamia's Malaviya Mission Teacher Training Centre has concluded a six-day training programme on the Indian Knowledge System and curriculum design in higher education, per a university press release dated Wednesday 30 September. The release page carries the headline and subject only, with the full text in an attached English PDF. Participant numbers, the dates on which the programme ran, the speakers and any outcomes are therefore not reported here.
stories.check: Details such as participants, dates and speakers are in the attached PDF, which was not opened for this brief.
